info.title: CLIR Credit Line Increase Request Business Objects
info.description: Business objects for the Credit Line Increase Request (CLIR) process application. Covers customer submission data, risk engine output, and the final approval decision.

RiskAssessment.description: Output of the Risk Assessment Engine. Drives gateway routing and is included in all audit events.

riskLevel.description: Evaluation result. Values: LOW_RISK, HIGH_RISK, AUTO_REJECT

riskReason.description: Detailed reason code or description for evaluation result

autoApproved.description: True only when riskLevel is LOW_RISK and automated approval is granted

assessedDate.description: Timestamp when the risk engine evaluated this request

engineVersion.description: Version of the risk rule engine that produced this assessment

ApprovalDecision.description: Final credit line decision, set by the system (auto-approval) or an underwriter.

status.description: Final decision. Values: APPROVED, REJECTED, PENDING_UNDERWRITER

approverComments.description: Notes and rationale from underwriter or system engine

processedBy.description: User ID of the underwriter, or SYSTEM for automated decisions

decisionTimestamp.description: Timestamp when the decision was recorded

bankingTxId.description: Transaction ID returned by the Core Banking API on successful limit update

CustomerInfo.description: Customer data submitted in the credit line increase request form.

fullName.description: Full legal name of the account holder

requestedIncrease.description: Target requested credit limit (the increase amount, not the new total)

submissionDate.description: Timestamp when the request was submitted
